[Benzinga news, 2026-10-29T22:02:31Z, by staff] CareDx Reports Q3 2026 Financial Results and Raises Full-Year Guidance
CareDx, Inc. reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $139.4 million, exceeding analyst expectations, and increased its full-year 2026 revenue and adjusted EBITDA guidance.
CareDx, Inc. announced its financial results for the third quarter of 2026, reporting revenue of $139.4 million, which surpassed the FactSet consensus estimate of $122.0 million. The company also reported an adjusted EPS of $0.70 for the quarter. Driven by strong performance, including a 51% year-over-year increase in testing volume and an adjusted EBITDA margin of 22%, the company raised its full-year 2026 outlook. CareDx now expects full-year 2026 revenue to be in the range of $520 million to $530 million, with adjusted EBITDA projected between $90 million and $100 million.

[Benzinga news, 2026-10-29T22:02:21Z, by staff] TPG Inc. Raises 2026 Fundraising Guidance
TPG Inc. increased its 2026 fundraising guidance to over $55 billion, supported by record dry powder and strong fundraising activity.
TPG Inc. has raised its fiscal year 2026 fundraising guidance to exceed $55 billion. The firm reported that its assets under management reached $346 billion, with dry powder hitting a record $86 billion. Additionally, the company provided a fee-related earnings (FRE) margin guidance of approximately 48%.

[Benzinga news, 2026-10-29T22:02:15Z, by staff] Twilio Inc. Reports Q3 2026 Financial Results and Raises Full-Year Guidance
Twilio Inc. reported third-quarter 2026 financial results, exceeding analyst expectations for both revenue and adjusted earnings per share, while raising its full-year outlook.
Twilio Inc. announced its third-quarter 2026 financial results, reporting revenue of $1.56 billion and an adjusted earnings per share (EPS) of $1.65, both surpassing FactSet consensus estimates of $1.52 billion and $1.47, respectively. The company also provided its outlook for the fourth quarter, projecting revenue between $1.60 billion and $1.61 billion and adjusted EPS in the range of $1.48 to $1.53. Additionally, Twilio raised its full-year 2026 guidance for revenue growth, non-GAAP operating income, and free cash flow, citing strengthened growth and cash flow performance during the quarter.
